# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Comprehensive multilingual dictionary and translation service from Cambridge University Press, offering authoritative definitions, translations, and usage examples across 19 languages.

Cambridge Dictionary provides English-French translations and bilingual dictionary entries with corpus-based examples from sources including the Cambridge English Corpus, Europarl Parallel Corpus, and Hansard archive. The platform serves language learners, translators, and anyone seeking authoritative word definitions and cross-language reference materials.
